title: A Markdown-only changeset has no credited check route: its prescribed landing checks (doc-link checker, AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md byte comparison) can never earn a host record
outcome: A repository can name its Markdown-only landing checks (for example `node scripts/check-doc-links.mjs` and `git diff --no-index --exit-code AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md`) so that TermAl records them as typed verification of a suitable kind (lint or a docs check, not a test), run either bare or through the focused launcher. A docs-only changeset's source change can then be recorded as checked rather than untested. Test credit stays reserved for real test runners.
acceptance: A design note, agreed with the Engram project, chooses the route (a declared non-test check kind, a lint-kind recognition of named commands, or another) and the kind the result is recorded as, with the reasons; it does not widen Test credit.

Tests show a declared or recognised docs check producing a typed verification record on pass and a failing record on a non-zero exit, and an unrelated non-test focused command still producing no record.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
